# =============================================================================
# Billable Hours — 1 · player, locations, people
# Map: two_hub. Two roots joined by the bus: linden_street (the house: hall, kitchen, study,
# upstairs with four rooms) and downtown
# (the firm, the hotel bar, the Velvet Room). Downtown is sealed: only the bus reaches it.
# =============================================================================

[player]
id           = "player"
name         = "Emma"
description  = "Emma, 21. First week as an intern at Callahan Reed."
customizable = false

[player.core_traits]
money        = 20
energy       = 100
nerve        = 0
office_talk  = 0
martin_stage = 0
ethan_stage  = 0
theo_stage   = 0
jade_stage   = 0

# ── Linden Street — the ground the house sits on ─────────────────────────────
[[locations]]
id                   = "linden_street"
name                 = "Linden Street"
kind                 = "thoroughfare"
description          = "A quiet suburban street of lawns and hedges. Martin's house is the big one with the black car in the drive. The bus stop into town is at the corner."
image                = "locations/linden_street.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["suburban street houses lawns morning", "bus stop suburban corner"]
navigation_order     = ["house"]

[[locations]]
id                   = "house"
name                 = "Home"
kind                 = "thoroughfare"   # the front hall: it only routes (the-map.md R2)
description          = "The front hall of Martin's house. The kitchen is straight ahead, Martin's study is off to the side, and the stairs go up to the bedrooms and the bathroom."
image                = "locations/house_hall.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["suburban house front hall staircase", "family home entrance hallway stairs evening"]
entry_from           = "linden_street"
navigation_order     = ["kitchen", "landing", "study"]

[[locations]]
id                   = "kitchen"
name                 = "The Kitchen"
description          = "The kitchen: the big table where the family eats breakfast and dinner. On Fridays Martin sits at the head of it and waits for his envelope."
image                = "locations/kitchen.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["family kitchen table morning suburban", "modern kitchen dinner table evening"]
entry_from           = "house"

[[locations]]
id                   = "landing"
name                 = "Upstairs"
kind                 = "thoroughfare"   # a hallway only; every room up here is its own location
description          = "The upstairs hall. Your room is at the back. The bathroom is across from Ethan's room, and Martin and Diane's room is at the front."
image                = "locations/landing.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["upstairs hallway bedroom doors", "dark upstairs hallway door ajar light"]
entry_from           = "house"
navigation_order     = ["her_room", "bathroom", "ethan_room", "parents_room"]

[[locations]]
id                   = "her_room"
name                 = "Your Room"
description          = "Your room: the small back bedroom with a single bed, a wardrobe of work clothes, and a door that shuts. This is where you sleep and dress."
image                = "locations/her_room.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["small bedroom single bed wardrobe", "young woman bedroom night lamp"]
entry_from           = "landing"

[[locations]]
id                   = "bathroom"
name                 = "The Bathroom"
description          = "The bathroom everyone shares. The shower is hot, and the door doesn't latch. Ethan's door is right across the hall."
image                = "locations/bathroom.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["family bathroom shower glass door", "bathroom door ajar steam light"]
entry_from           = "landing"

[[locations]]
id                   = "ethan_room"
name                 = "Ethan's Room"
description          = "Ethan's room: a desk covered in files and red pens, an unmade bed, a tub of protein powder. He's in here most nights after nine."
image                = "locations/ethan_room.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["young man bedroom desk files unmade bed", "male bedroom desk lamp night"]
entry_from           = "landing"

[[locations]]
id                   = "parents_room"
name                 = "Martin and Diane's Room"
description          = "Martin and Diane's bedroom: a big bed, your mother's dresser with her pearls on it, and Martin's side with the whisky glass on the nightstand."
image                = "locations/parents_room.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["master bedroom big bed dresser lamp", "parents bedroom nightstand whisky glass"]
entry_from           = "landing"

[[locations]]
id                   = "study"
name                 = "Martin's Study"
description          = "Martin's study: a leather armchair, a desk, a decanter of whisky. It's where he works in the evenings with the door shut, and where he sees you on Fridays."
image                = "locations/study.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["home study leather armchair lamp", "dark wood study desk whisky decanter"]
entry_from           = "house"
hours                = [ { weekdays = [4], open = "19:00", close = "22:00" } ]
closed_text          = "Martin's study. The door is shut. He sees you on Friday evenings."

# ── downtown — the second ground, reached only by the bus ───────────────────
[[locations]]
id                   = "downtown"
name                 = "Downtown"
kind                 = "thoroughfare"
description          = "The block downtown: Callahan Reed's glass tower, the hotel bar across the road where the partners take clients, and the Velvet Room's red sign round the corner. The bus home stops outside the tower."
image                = "locations/downtown.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["downtown office tower street evening", "city street hotel neon sign night"]
navigation_order     = ["firm", "hotel_bar", "club"]
auto_exit            = false   # sealed: only the bus reaches it (the-map.md R3). The bus home is the way out.

[[locations]]
id                   = "firm"
name                 = "Callahan Reed"
description          = "Callahan Reed, the law firm: open-plan desks, the copy room, the partners' glass offices. Interns file, copy and fetch for $70 a day. Your mother's desk sits outside Martin's office."
image                = "locations/firm.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["law firm office open plan glass", "corporate office copy room"]
entry_from           = "downtown"
hours                = [ { weekdays = [0, 1, 2, 4], open = "08:00", close = "19:00" }, { weekdays = [3], open = "08:00", close = "21:00" } ]
closed_text          = "Callahan Reed is shut. It opens at eight, Monday to Friday, and closes at seven (nine on Thursdays)."
clothing_rules       = [ { slots_required = ["top", "bottom", "shoes"], message = "The receptionist looks you up and down. \"Callahan Reed has a dress code. Go home and change.\"" } ]

[[locations]]
id                   = "hotel_bar"
name                 = "The Hotel Bar"
description          = "The hotel bar across the road from the firm: low lights, leather stools, a long mirror behind the bottles. It's where the partners bring clients. A drink is $8."
image                = "locations/hotel_bar.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["hotel bar leather stools low light", "upscale hotel bar evening"]
entry_from           = "downtown"
hours                = [ { open = "17:00", close = "23:00" } ]
closed_text          = "The hotel bar opens at five."

[[locations]]
id                   = "club"
name                 = "The Velvet Room"
description          = "The Velvet Room, a strip club: a lit stage with a pole, a long bar, red booths in the dark. Jade dances here most nights. A drink is $8."
image                = "locations/club.jpg"
image_search_queries = ["strip club stage pole red lights", "nightclub bar red booths dark"]
entry_from           = "downtown"
hours                = [ { weekdays = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5], open = "21:00", close = "24:00" } ]
closed_text          = "The Velvet Room opens at nine, Monday to Saturday."

# ── the people ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# =============================================================================
# Billable Hours — 5 · the people hubs (portraits)
# Each hub: repeatable, `npc` on the trigger (the face and the presence gate,
# engine.md §42), gated on the meeting flag (F5), a leak that shows his want (A13).
# =============================================================================

# ── Martin at breakfast — the leak, and his want +1 a day (capped at 14 in v0.1)
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_martin_breakfast"
name = "Martin at breakfast"
description = "Martin's hub. The leak by stage; reads her outfit and Ethan's face. Raises his want +1 a day, cap 14."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "kitchen"
npc           = "npc_martin"
requires_npc  = "npc_martin"
is_repeatable = true
priority      = 6
is_active     = true

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"
logic   = "AND"
items = [
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "opening_done",    operator = "is_true" },
  { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "breakfast_today", operator = "is_false" },
]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "table"
name = "Breakfast"
blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "time_of_day", start_time = "07:00", end_time = "08:30" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Martin pours your coffee without asking how you take it. He already knows." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Martin is at the kitchen table with a whisky and a stack of files. He moves the chair beside him out with his foot." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He looks at you like he's already decided something." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "The jacket, Emma. Friday." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "eq", value = 1 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Your chair's free on Friday." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Friday, Emma." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He looks at you over the top of his glasses." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "worn_corruption", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes go down your tight blouse and stay there long enough that your mother clears her throat at the stove." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes stay on you a beat too long, and then he turns the page." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Behind you your mother moves around the kitchen, humming." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "ethan_saw_front", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "Ethan is staring at his plate like it's a contract." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Something wrong with your eggs, Ethan?" },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He reaches past you for the milk." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "theo_hour_paid", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Crisp notes in your envelope this week. Resourceful. I won't ask where from. Not yet." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He turns back to his reading." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He finishes his coffee." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_martin", trait_key = "martin_want", operator = "gte", value = 10 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His hand rests on the back of your chair, and then on your shoulder, and stays there while he reads. He doesn't bother hiding it from the room any more." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His arm brushes yours and he doesn't apologise." },
  ] } },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Sit with him."
targetType = "location"
locationId = "kitchen"
time_progression_minutes = 15
flagEffects = [ { targetType = "player", flag = "breakfast_today", op = "set" } ]
effects = [ { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_want", op = "add", value = 1, cap = 14 } ]

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Say you're busy and go."
targetType = "node"
nodeId     = "hub_martin_breakfast.busy"
show_when_locked = true
flagEffects = [ { targetType = "player", flag = "breakfast_today", op = "set" } ]
effects = [ { targetType = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin", trait = "martin_power", op = "add", value = 1, clamp = true } ]
conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "npc", npc_id = "npc_martin", trait_key = "martin_power", operator = "lt", value = 10 } ] }

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "busy"
name = "Busy"
blocks = [
  { type = "paragraph", content = "You say you're late and grab your bag. He lets you go without looking up." },
  { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_martin" }, content = "Friday, Emma. You won't be busy on Friday." },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "location"
text = "Go."

[canvases.nodes.exit_block.config]
destinationType          = "specific"
locationId               = "kitchen"
time_progression_minutes = 5

# ── Diane in the evening ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_diane_home"
name = "Your mother"
description = "Diane's hub at home. Worried; reads office talk and whether Fridays are 'sweet'."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "kitchen"
npc           = "npc_diane"
requires_npc  = "npc_diane"
is_repeatable = true
priority      = 6
is_active     = true

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"
logic   = "AND"
items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "opening_done", operator = "is_true" } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "talk"
name = "Your mother"
blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "office_talk", operator = "gte", value = 3 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "People at the firm talk, sweetheart. Don't give them anything to talk about. Martin's name is on that door." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "diane_blessed_fridays", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "I love that you and Martin have your Fridays now. It means a lot to him. It means a lot to me." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Are you eating properly? You look tired. Is Callahan being fair to you?" },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She pats the chair next to hers at the table." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "martin_stage", operator = "gte", value = 2 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "You and Martin were up so late on Friday. He came to bed humming. I haven't seen him like that in years." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "The TV on the counter murmurs." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "parents_bed_used", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Martin says I've started making his side of the bed too neatly. I haven't touched it." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "She squeezes your hand." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_passed", operator = "is_false" }, { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_failed", operator = "is_false" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Week twelve, sweetheart. I've told everyone you'll be kept on. Don't let me down." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_failed", operator = "is_true" }, { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "review_passed", operator = "is_false" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Probation. I told everyone it was a formality, sweetheart. Make it one." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_diane" }, content = "Kept on. I told everyone you would be. Now go and get that contract signed." },
  ] } },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Tell her it's fine."
targetType = "location"
locationId = "kitchen"
time_progression_minutes = 10

# ── Ethan in his room ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_ethan_landing"
name = "Ethan's door"
description = "Ethan's hub. The leak: his door is open an inch, and only when yours is. Reads what she is wearing."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "ethan_room"
npc           = "npc_ethan"
requires_npc  = "npc_ethan"
is_repeatable = true
priority      = 6
is_active     = true

[canvases.trigger.conditions]
version = "1.0"
logic   = "AND"
items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "met_family", operator = "is_true" } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "door"
name = "His door"
blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "ethan_stage", operator = "gte", value = 1 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His door is open an inch. It's only ever open when yours is." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_ethan" }, content = "What. Did you want something, or are you just standing there?" },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He's at his desk, marking something up in red. When you lean in his doorway his pen stops, and he looks you up and down before he looks away." },
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_ethan" }, content = "Night, intern." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "Behind you, across the hall, the bathroom door stands open." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "ethan_bed_used", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_ethan" }, content = "Somebody's been in my bed. It smelled like you." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "ethan_caught_snooping", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_ethan" }, content = "Stay out of my desk, intern." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He waits for you to say something." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "touch_loud", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_ethan" }, content = "Thin walls, intern. Some of us are trying to sleep." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "ethan_shut_out", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_ethan" }, content = "You shut the door on me. It doesn't lock, you know. We both know." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "ethan_watched_shower", operator = "is_true" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_ethan" }, content = "Shower's free. If you're going." },
  ] } },
  { type = "group", props = { blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "He doesn't say anything else." },
  ] } },
  { type = "paragraph", content = "He doesn't ask you in." },
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "clothing_item", item_id = "sleep_shirt", operator = "equipped" } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "paragraph", content = "His eyes drop to your bare legs under the sleep shirt, and he forgets what he was going to say." },
  ] } },
]

[canvases.nodes.exit_block]
type = "choices"

[[canvases.nodes.exit_block.choices]]
text       = "Say goodnight."
targetType = "location"
locationId = "landing"

# ── Callahan in the corner office ────────────────────────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_callahan"
name = "Callahan"

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "firm"
npc           = "npc_callahan"
requires_npc  = "npc_callahan"
is_repeatable = true
priority      = 6

[canvases.trigger.conditions]

items = [ { type = "flag", subject = "player", flag_key = "met_callahan", operator = "is_true" } ]

[[canvases.nodes]]
id   = "office"

blocks = [
  { type = "group", props = { conditions = { version = "1.0", logic = "AND", items = [ { type = "trait", subject = "player", trait_key = "office_talk", operator = "gte", value = 5 } ] }, blocks = [
    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_callahan" }, content = "People are talking about you, Emma. That's either very good for you or very bad. Week twelve, I'll know which." },

    { type = "dialog", props = { speaker = "npc", npcId = "npc_callahan" }, content = "Not now, Emma. Show me at week twelve." },

    { type = "paragraph", content = "His espresso has gone cold again." },

]

# ── Diane at her desk ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[[canvases]]
id   = "hub_diane_desk"
name = "Your mother's desk"
description = "Diane at the firm, outside Martin's office. She sees who goes in."

[canvases.trigger]
location      = "firm"

# =============================================================================
# Billable Hours — 0 · systems spec
# [project] [settings] [time] [engine] [ui] [player_portrait] [traits] [[sidebar_items]] [[clothing]]
# Built from the signed sheets (sheets/, DECISIONS.md) and the ledger (v2_state.json).

[project]
id              = "billable_hours"
title           = "Billable Hours"
description     = "Emma, 21, starts an internship at the law firm where her stepfather is a partner. He paid off her card, and every Friday he takes $250 of her week. Her mother is his assistant. Her step-brother is an associate there and says she didn't earn the job. The house runs on who is in the next room; the firm runs on what she wants."
starting_canvas = "opening_boot"
version         = "0.1"
release_date    = "2026-10-01"
quests_engine   = "v2"

[settings]
narration_person  = "second"
clothing_enabled  = true
wardrobe_location = "her_room"

# The engine collects the bill (engine.md §26). No authored scene takes the money.
[settings.rent]
enabled          = true
amount           = 250
due_day          = "Friday"
collector_npc    = "npc_martin"
start_after_flag = "firm_day1_done"
stages      = [ { amount = 250, after_total_paid = 0 }, { amount = 300, after_total_paid = 500 }, { amount = 350, after_total_paid = 1400 } ]
stage_lines = [
  "Martin folds the envelope into his jacket without counting it. \"Two-fifty. Every Friday, Emma.\"",
  "Martin counts it this time. \"Your mother's card was in your name too. Three hundred from next Friday.\"",
  "\"Three-fifty,\" Martin says, and puts the envelope away. \"That's the last number, Emma. It stays there.\"",
]
on_short         = "carry"
currency_symbol  = "$"

[settings.rent.text]
title         = "Friday"
scene         = "It's Friday. Martin is at the kitchen table with his coffee, and there's an empty space on the table in front of him where the envelope goes."
greeting      = "\"Friday, Emma.\" He doesn't look up from the paper."
paid_scene    = "You put the envelope down. He slides it over with two fingers and it's gone into his jacket."
paid_response = "\"Good girl.\" Your mother smiles at the stove like she didn't hear it."
paid_closing  = "Go to work."
cant_pay      = "You don't have it. He looks at you over the paper for a long time. \"Then it's owed. Next Friday it's all of it.\""
partial_pay   = "He counts what you've got and puts it away. \"The rest next week, Emma. I keep track.\""

[time]
enabled       = true
starting_hour = 7
starting_day  = "Monday"
starting_week = 1

# Day caps: each flag is set on the choice that spends it and cleared here (engine.md §28).
[engine.daily_tick]
flagEffects = [

]

[project]
id              = "billable_hours"
title           = "Billable Hours"
description     = "Emma, 21, starts an internship at the law firm where her stepfather is a partner. He paid off her card, and every Friday he takes $250 of her week. Her mother is his assistant. Her step-brother is an associate there and says she didn't earn the job. The house runs on who is in the next room; the firm runs on what she wants."
starting_canvas = "opening_boot"
version         = "0.1"
release_date    = "2026-10-01"
quests_engine   = "v2"

[settings]
narration_person  = "second"
clothing_enabled  = true
wardrobe_location = "her_room"

# The engine collects the bill (engine.md §26). No authored scene takes the money.
[settings.rent]
enabled          = true
amount           = 250
due_day          = "Friday"
collector_npc    = "npc_martin"
start_after_flag = "firm_day1_done"
stages      = [ { amount = 250, after_total_paid = 0 }, { amount = 300, after_total_paid = 500 }, { amount = 350, after_total_paid = 1400 } ]
stage_lines = [
  "Martin folds the envelope into his jacket without counting it. \"Two-fifty. Every Friday, Emma.\"",
  "Martin counts it this time. \"Your mother's card was in your name too. Three hundred from next Friday.\"",
  "\"Three-fifty,\" Martin says, and puts the envelope away. \"That's the last number, Emma. It stays there.\"",
]
on_short         = "carry"
currency_symbol  = "$"

[settings.rent.text]
title         = "Friday"
scene         = "It's Friday. Martin is at the kitchen table with his coffee, and there's an empty space on the table in front of him where the envelope goes."
greeting      = "\"Friday, Emma.\" He doesn't look up from the paper."
paid_scene    = "You put the envelope down. He slides it over with two fingers and it's gone into his jacket."
paid_response = "\"Good girl.\" Your mother smiles at the stove like she didn't hear it."
paid_closing  = "Go to work."
cant_pay      = "You don't have it. He looks at you over the paper for a long time. \"Then it's owed. Next Friday it's all of it.\""
partial_pay   = "He counts what you've got and puts it away. \"The rest next week, Emma. I keep track.\""

[time]
enabled       = true
starting_hour = 7
starting_day  = "Monday"
starting_week = 1

# Day caps: each flag is set on the choice that spends it and cleared here (engine.md §28).
[engine.daily_tick]

All four are explicit or banded on nerve, and the dishes and cooking scenes can raise Martin's want, capped at 14 like everything else that raises it.

I also added three new once-a-day flags to the daily reset in `0_systems_spec.toml`, and gave Martin two breakfast reactions in `5_scenes.toml`: one when she's been drinking his whisky, one when she's used his chair. All six files parse. I didn't merge, build or run the gates, so nothing has been scored yet. The explicit scenes point at six new video folders (`sex/kitchen_*`) that have no clips in them yet, and I didn't update the game's ledger (`v2_state.json`).
